photos.c: 1.At 16 James Tuson's a bit of an all-rounder. Last season, in his first year as an U17M he high jumped 1.80, long jumped 5.75, tripled 13.10 and cropped up regularly in sprints and relays. James is our U17M T&F Captain for 1997.
All-rounder James Tuson takes over as Under 17 Men's Captain this summer and will be geeing the boys up for an even better showing in 1997.
Below: Still a Junior but James Tuson seems to have been competing in Southern League matches for years.
